before_times: a tour, a place or a drop-in day
the child's age in months or years (sets the room), from the parent's words; the AI passes only the age
full-time or part-time, and the start date wanted
away: a family event or a workplace, the date and hours, and how many children with their ages
after_time: will the child come to the tour
away: the room for the kids, the way in, and who from the family stays on site
secure_page_only: the parent's or guardian's yes that they may enroll and sign for the child
the child's first name and birth date
health and shot records, or the state's exemption form, where the state's rules require them
allergies, medicines and health needs, with the doctor's plan where one is needed, and the medicine permission form
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home, and anyone who may not, with any court order uploaded
intake_questions.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian, 18 or older, books and signs for the child; a teen can't book alone; away, the host books, and each child's own parent fills that child's form

stop.words: a child hurt, missing or in danger right now
a report of abuse or neglect of a child, at the center or anywhere
stop.say: If a child is in danger now, call 911. A person on Rosie's team follows up, and you can call the state's child abuse hotline.
stop.booking: no booking in that chat; a person on Rosie's team follows the state's reporting steps where they apply

go_on.words: an allergy, asthma, a medicine or a health need
go_on.what: the answer goes only on the secure page; the booking goes on, and Sam reads anything the plug-in marks before a place is offered; Rosie gives no health advice

go_on.words: a custody order, or someone who may not pick up
go_on.what: only on the secure page, with the order uploaded; never in a text; the booking goes on

go_on.words: asks if a child is too sick to come
go_on.what: no advice from Rosie: the center's own sick-child rules, shown on the page, and the director answers by phone

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Tour with the director
steps.when: before a place is offered; good for 3 months
steps.who: the parent, with the child welcome
steps.result: on file: a place can be booked; not yet: the tour is booked first and saved with the place

steps.name: Enrollment forms
steps.when: on the secure page; due by 6pm the business day before the first day (a drop-in day: before booking)
steps.words: the center's admission form, health and shot records or the state's exemption where the state's rules require them, allergies and medicine permission, emergency contacts, the pick-up list
steps.result: done: the child can start; not done by the due time: Sam decides to keep, move or cancel with no fee; the child never starts without them

steps.name: Trial morning (optional, the center's setting)
steps.when: after a place is booked and before the first full day; free with the place, 9:00am to 1:00pm, the parent stays the first 30 minutes
steps.who: the child, with the parent at the start
steps.result: the family keeps the place, asks for a change, or withdraws by the end of that day with everything paid back, as the master's 'not the right fit' does (A7-34, A7-36); no answer by 6pm keeps the place; keeping a nonrefundable fee is a gap for the master; a center that runs no trial morning skips it

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: a labeled bag with 2 changes of clothes, diapers and wipes if used, a labeled cup, a crib sheet and a small blanket for nap; meals and snacks are the center's; away, a room for the kids' corner, away from the pool, the kitchen and the stairs

staff.skills: infant care, toddlers and twos, preschool, event care
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no person license unless the state's form names one; the director's and teachers' training and credentials where the state's rules require them, as switches
staff.who_oks: Sam, the owner and director, OKs every place (Rosie never picks who gets one), every fee, and any event over 6 hours; Pat answers Lee Kids Events requests and its prices over $500, and the center's requests only while Sam is away (AWAY); a new adult on a pick-up list is added only by the parent on the secure page, never by Sam, by phone or by text
staff.stand_in: a teacher out: another teacher cleared for that age covers the room; families are told only if their child's lead teacher changes for more than a day
staff.ratio: each room's child-to-teacher limit by age, a switch from the state's form; a helper under 18 never counts toward it

children_and_age.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian, 18 or older, books and signs for the child; a teen can't book alone; away, the host books, and each child's own parent fills that child's form
children_and_age.minors_texts: every text about a child goes to the parent or guardian who booked, never to the child

visit.check_in: at the center: the parent gives the child's check-in code at the front desk at drop-off, and the teacher ticks the child in on the room's list; a tour: the code at the front desk; away: the host's code at the door when the teachers arrive
visit.done: the drop-off code and the check-out at pick-up; a tour: the code at the desk; away, the code at the start, and DONE from the lead teacher

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: from the state's form: a child care center license where the state's rules require one (most states license centers that care for children for pay); care away from the center (a kids' room at an event or a workplace) and babysitting need a license only where the state's form says so
license.who: the center holds its license; the event company gives its business registration, and a license only where the state's form names one
license.ask: the center's license number and the agency that issued it, in the state's own words; the event company's registration number
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks; the amount shown only as the center's word; a workplace or a venue may ask for proof before a kids' room there
license.background: a switch from the state's form: where the state requires background checks for adults who work with children, each teacher's check is asked for (who ran it, and the date) and shown as the center's word, never as checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: a child's health, allergies, medicines, shot records, custody orders, who may and may not pick up, incidents and behavior never go in a text or through the AI; only the child's age passes through the AI, to set the room; texts to the owner or staff carry none of these and no age, only the parent's first name and last initial, the room and a link to the secure page
